name: auto-follow-up-rpc
description: autoFollowUp is on and TYPESAFE_API_KEY is unset. A prompt sent over RPC while the agent runs a tool is queued as steering with source rpc, which the handler leaves alone: no warning, no Jev call, and no refusal of the setting at session start. (The interactive path, where Jev is called, cannot be reached over RPC: the endpoint is hardcoded and the source is rpc; layer-1 tests and the twins cover it.)

steps.name: slash command while the tool runs
